gbm_population_evidence.quote: Safety and Efficacy of Bevacizumab in Combination With NaviFUS System for the Treatment of Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme (rGBM)

Patients diagnosed with glioblastoma must have unequivocal evidence of recurrence, as determined by contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI), following prior radiotherapy and temozolomide chemotherapy.

candidate_evidence.quote: This will be a prospective, open-label, single-arm pilot study to investigate the safety and efficacy of Bevacizumab (BEV) in combination with microbubble (MB)-mediated FUS in patients with recurrent GBM.

BEV represents the physician's best choice for the standard of care (SoC) in rGBM after previous treatment with surgery (if appropriate), standard radiotherapy with temozolomide chemotherapy, and with adjuvant temozolomide.

candidate_flag.reason: Only drug tested is bevacizumab (an established GBM therapy, D6) with FUS-enabled BBB opening; rule 6 (established_therapy_experiment) applied, but C12/R5 (device-enabled delivery as the question = candidate) could be argued, which would make the trial eligible.
